_about: Business questions with expected answers from hand-written gold SQL. An agent answer counts as correct if its final query result or its text contains the expected value (numbers within 1%). Expected values are unrounded. v2 of the set rewords the customer-count question to be explicit about order status (it conflicted with the agent's default rule of excluding canceled orders).

questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'

questions.q: How many unique customers have placed an order (of any status)?
How many sellers are on the marketplace?
Which product category generated the most product revenue?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM gold.fact_sales f JOIN gold.dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(price) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the average review score of delivered orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(review_score) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'

questions.q: Which customer state has the most orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.state FROM gold.fact_orders o JOIN gold.dim_customer c USING(customer_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the most common payment type?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT payment_type FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE payment_type IS NOT NULL AND order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What percentage of delivered orders arrived late?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT 100*avg(is_late::INT) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND is_late IS NOT NULL

questions.q: In which month (YYYY-MM) were the most orders placed?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime(purchased_at,'%Y-%m') FROM gold.fact_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the average delivery time in days for delivered orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(delivery_days) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status='delivered'
SELECT count(*) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status='canceled'

questions.q: What is the average review score for orders that arrived late?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(review_score) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE is_late

questions.q: Which seller state has the most sellers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT state FROM gold.dim_seller GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: How many customers placed more than one order?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_key FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)

questions.q: What was total product revenue in 2017?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT sum(price) FROM gold.fact_sales f JOIN gold.dim_date d ON f.purchase_date_key=d.date_key WHERE d.year=2017 AND order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

questions.q: What is the average number of payment installments for credit card orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(installments) FROM gold.fact_orders WHERE payment_type='credit_card' AND order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

questions.q: Which product category has the lowest average review score among categories with at least 500 items sold?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM gold.fact_sales f JOIN gold.dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=500 ORDER BY avg(review_score) LIMIT 1

questions.q: What share of revenue comes from the top 10 sellers, in percent?
questions.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT seller_key, sum(price) r FROM gold.fact_sales WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY 1) SELECT 100*(SELECT sum(r) FROM (SELECT r FROM s ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 10))/sum(r) FROM s
